name: 09-dining-room-empty
prompt: Wide establishing shot of an empty, intimate private dining room before guests arrive, one round table for twelve laid with crystal and candles, dark wood panelling, soft pink and gold neon rings glowing on the back wall. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
